'''Yavin''' was the small [[Color/Legends|orange]] primary of the [[Yavin system/Legends|Yavin system]]. It was [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] by two [[Planet/Legends|planets]] and a captured [[Comet/Legends|comet]].<ref name="TEA" />
